title: fix(mcp): preserve the account balance breakdown in getBalance
author: ale-rls

gist.summary: Fixed the MCP getBalance service dropping the gateway's accountBalance breakdown, which includes paid Pollen available for paid-only models. It still returns the existing pollen and note fields and omits accountBalance when the gateway does not provide it. Added a focused regression test using the existing fetch helper.
